caption: The video captures four riders seated single-file on a long, narrow white board planing across a greenish lake in mid-ride, viewed from a side-rear angle. A person in a gray hooded sweatshirt sits at the front, followed by a blonde woman in a white tank top, a small child in a blue life vest, and a man in a white T-shirt and cap at the rear, with a black object behind him. The board throws a frothy white wake that trails to the right, churning and lengthening as the clip advances, while the riders hold their order with only minor postural shifts. As the camera pans and zooms, the group drifts toward the left edge and appears progressively smaller against the densely forested hillside. A dark paddle blade comes into view left of the front rider in later frames. The shoreline scrolls past the distant red kayak, confirming steady relative motion.
relations: The board's forward planing generates a frothy wake trailing right, churning and lengthening as it advances.
Riders maintain their single-file seating order with only minor postural shifts during the continuous motion.
Camera panning and zooming makes the group drift left and appear progressively smaller against the hillside.
Steady relative motion causes the shoreline to scroll past the distant red kayak, and a paddle blade enters view.
